results.question: What is total net revenue for each top-level product category (the categories that have no parent)?
results.goldSql: SELECT parent.CategoryName, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId JOIN catalog.Categories c ON c.CategoryId = p.CategoryId JOIN catalog.Categories parent ON parent.CategoryId = c.ParentCategoryId GROUP BY parent.CategoryName
results.sql:
SELECT
    c.[CategoryName],
    SUM(oi.[Quantity] * oi.[UnitPrice] * (1 - oi.[DiscountPct])) AS [TotalNetRevenue]
FROM [catalog].[Categories] AS c
INNER JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS p
    ON p.[CategoryId] = c.[CategoryId]
INNER JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
    ON oi.[ProductId] = p.[ProductId]
WHERE c.[ParentCategoryId] IS NULL
GROUP BY c.[CategoryId], c.[CategoryName];

results.question: How many units of discontinued products were sold in 2025, counting every order line regardless of order status?
results.goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity) AS Units FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId JOIN sales.Orders o ON o.OrderId = oi.OrderId WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 1 AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity) AS UnitsSold
FROM [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
JOIN [sales].[Orders] AS o
    ON o.OrderId = oi.OrderId
JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS p
    ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 1
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01';
